192 raw findings from 8 parallel domain audits; each adversarially verified by a

confirmed.what_is_stale: automation-repo.md declares "AGENTS.md is the authority for this repo ... Measured accuracy is split: AGENTS.md correct on suites (71/5/12/8/3 verified) and payload helpers (66 verified by `grep -oE "public [A-Za-z0-9_]*PayLoadHelper get[A-Za-z0-9_]+\(\)" | wc -l` = 66); bootstrap CLAUDE.md correct on src/main (App.java exists), default env (Automation.Properties: `Environment=QA_MsSQL`), headlessMode (0 of 20 env files define it).
confirmed.proposed_update: Pick one authority and state it once. Recommended: make `pam_automation_bootstrap/CLAUDE.md` authoritative (it is the file the harness actually loads), have it `@AGENTS.md` for the graph/CI sections AGENTS.md owns, and reduce automation-repo.md:10-16 to a pointer rather than a competing precedence claim.
